title: Land boot state-load subphase measurements before the next Central restart
outcome: The next Central host build can report the actual state-load subphase costs while optimization and cold/warm comparison remain separate follow-up work.
acceptance: Boot state loading emits fixed-label aggregate durations for SQLite open, schema and metadata, session loading with transcript-tail and prompt-history sub-phases, session and derived-state reconstruction, and federation binding, without changing the persistence format or restore behavior.

Disposable-state validation preserves restored transcript tails, prompt history and malformed-row quarantine with measurements enabled and disabled; fixture measurements label the first load and reopens as write-warmed and make no cold-cache claim.

The instrumentation-only change has no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher review finding, passes the full gate on its exact landing input, and is committed and pushed on master; optimization and real Central cold/warm evidence remain on the parent task.
